description: Sourced reasons for season reference entries (data/audit/we-season-reference/<season>.json) that the completeness matcher does not pair with a west-end row. same-production: the entry is that existing row under another title; counts as present only while the row exists and starts within 75 days of the entry. out-of-scope: the entry is outside what the site lists (category must be in OUT_OF_SCOPE_CATEGORIES, scripts/lib/we-season-reference.js); it leaves the in-scope denominator and is still printed by the audit. Entries are matched by exact reference title + start. Every other miss stays an open gap to promote.

2012-2013.title: Untold Stories (Hymn & Cocktail Sticks)
2012-2013.reason: Same Duchess Theatre run, 2013-03-22 to 2013-06-15, as the existing row titled Alan Bennett's Untold Stories; Hymn and Cocktail Sticks are the two plays that make up that bill.
